g.text: Company Information / Services Information / Computational Basis
Manage Atlas standard formulas, client assignments, policy scenarios, and linked reference sources used by automatic payroll calculation.
Built-in formulas are read-only; company calculations are editable here.
Create a governed computation with the approved field and operator palette, then assign it to the applicable employee group.
Client Admin role. Built-in rows expose View only; the lock glyph replaces Edit and Delete and points to Settings › Standard
Computation Library. In the P&A Admin role the same rows show View, Edit and (for company computations) Delete, and the
notice above the table switches to the violet function icon.
